requirement: Scenario and generated output pack must identify the current archive version.
failure_meaning: A reviewer may be looking at stale synthetic outputs from a prior release.
notes: Version drift is treated as evidence-boundary drift.

requirement: Synthetic outputs must say they are not live deployment evidence.
failure_meaning: Synthetic examples could be mistaken for real election evidence.
notes: Non-claims are part of the public safety boundary.

requirement: Every scenario phase must expose a safe public sentence.
failure_meaning: Technical packets would lack a public-language interpretation boundary.
notes: Public comprehension is part of the security model.

requirement: Every scenario packet must have a manifest and pass public offline verification.
failure_meaning: The smallest pilot path contains a broken or unverified packet reference.
notes: This is a synthetic rehearsal gate, not a live certification.

requirement: The output pack must contain evidence map, smoke report, court index, and public quickstart.
failure_meaning: An adopter can verify packets but cannot hand a coherent bundle to public, observer, or court-facing readers.
notes: The pack is intentionally derived from scenario.json to avoid hand-maintained drift.

requirement: Pre-pilot evidence ledgers must include current-release status rows.
failure_meaning: A release may claim readiness while its evidence ledgers describe an older state.
notes: Historical rows may remain; a current row is still required.

requirement: Court-facing synthetic index must preserve non-claims about outcome correctness and intent/fraud.
failure_meaning: Evidence preservation language could be overread as legal or factual proof beyond the packet.
notes: This is not legal advice; live use requires counsel-reviewed jurisdiction worksheets.

requirement: The invariant registry itself must resolve all referenced artifacts and name enforcing checks.
failure_meaning: The meta-check for pilot readiness is descriptive only and cannot be audited.
notes: This keeps the added invariants machine-readable instead of essay-only.

requirement: Trust-recovery output pack must remain current, non-claiming, and derived from the playbook.
failure_meaning: A verifier failure or ambiguous evidence state may lack a bounded public and preservation handoff path.
notes: This keeps failure semantics executable instead of prose-only.

requirement: Human-review output pack must remain current, synthetic-only, and bound to reviewer roles and non-claims.
failure_meaning: Verifier failures or ambiguous evidence states may lack accountable human review and public boundary language.
notes: Keeps human review executable and synthetic-only rather than essay-only.

requirement: Every evaluator scenario must map to trust-recovery and human-review handoff IDs.
failure_meaning: An adversarial scenario could lack a bounded recovery owner, public sentence, or reviewer handoff.
notes: Turns evaluator scenarios into operational routes instead of isolated examples.

requirement: Evidence-retention dispositions must name minimum preserved fields, redaction floors, owners, and non-claims.
failure_meaning: Evidence preservation or redaction may become improvised, overbroad, or under-preserved.
notes: Live use still requires local retention periods and counsel-reviewed routing.

requirement: Synthetic evaluator scorecard must be current, full-pass, and explicitly non-certifying.
failure_meaning: The rehearsal may look complete without a bounded evaluation result or could be mistaken for certification.
notes: A scorecard PASS is only internal synthetic closure under this archive release; it is not live deployment evidence.

requirement: Synthetic negative-control fixtures must reject tampered temporary packets with expected problem codes.
failure_meaning: The rehearsal may show valid packets passing without proving common tampering patterns fail closed.
notes: Expected-failure PASS is a verifier regression guard only; not live deployment evidence or certification.

requirement: Release maintainer handoff must summarize current synthetic outputs, source-review triage, residual non-live items, and gate inventory.
failure_meaning: A maintainer could publish a release without a compact view of what changed, which synthetic outputs are current, and which source reviews need attention.
notes: The handoff is a release-maintenance summary only; it is not a full release-gate transcript or live election evidence.

requirement: Release go/no-go pack must separate synthetic release readiness from live-pilot certification current-authority legal-use and offline-drill promotion conditions.
failure_meaning: A maintainer could treat an internally consistent synthetic release as live pilot approval or current public authority.
notes: The go/no-go record is synthetic release governance only; it is not certification live deployment evidence current voter instruction or legal advice.

requirement: Local-pilot intake must remain a visible no-go until jurisdiction-specific authority source privacy retention review and legal evidence is added.
failure_meaning: A maintainer could confuse synthetic release readiness with local live-pilot readiness.
notes: The intake pack is a synthetic release-support no-go; it is not live authorization current voter instruction certification or legal advice.

requirement: Redaction/publication pack must remain a visible no-go until public/private field separation and reviewer approval exist for local evidence.
failure_meaning: A maintainer could publish local evidence-derived artifacts that expose voter witness staff device network safety or legal-review data.
notes: The redaction pack is synthetic release support only; it is not legal advice public-records ruling public-release authorization or live election evidence.

requirement: Accessibility/language pack must remain a visible no-go until local accessibility language-access plain-language fallback and human-help review exists for voter-facing artifacts.
failure_meaning: A maintainer could publish voter-facing artifacts that are digest-correct and privacy-reviewed but unusable, untranslated, inaccessible, or missing safe human help routes.
notes: The accessibility/language pack is synthetic release support only; it is not legal advice accessibility certification language-coverage determination current voter instruction or live election evidence.

requirement: Evidence custody/provenance pack must remain a visible no-go until local capture authorization collector role tool/time-source transfer access public-derivative chain-gap and disposition records exist.
failure_meaning: A maintainer could treat digest-valid synthetic packets as live field evidence without accountable custody handling or chain-gap records.
notes: The custody/provenance pack is synthetic release support only; it is not chain-of-custody certification admissibility opinion legal advice live authorization or live election evidence.

requirement: Independent-review/conflict pack must remain a visible no-go until reviewer scope conflicts qualifications transcript dissent public-summary approval access-chain and remediation/retest records exist.
failure_meaning: A maintainer could describe self-tested synthetic outputs as independent validation or third-party review without reviewer conflict scope transcript dissent or retest evidence.
notes: The independent-review/conflict pack is synthetic release support only; it is not third-party validation certification live authorization authorization to test live systems legal advice or live election evidence.

requirement: The synthetic pilot path must map the seven mission-kernel elements to concrete evidence refs, owner roles, closure tests, and live blockers before publication.
failure_meaning: A synthetic PASS could be mistaken for field readiness because mission-kernel gaps are not explicitly mapped.
notes: Synthetic closeout only; live pilot remains no-go until the named blocker evidence exists.
